video_title: 76ers, Cavs or Warriors? 👀 Who will go ALL-IN for LeBron James? 🎲 | NBA Today

quotes.speaker: Shams Charania
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James' free agency process involves gathering information through Rich Paul
quotes.excerpt: all of the information so far has funneled through agent Rich Paul with LeBron James.
quotes.quote: All of the information so far has funneled through agent Rich Paul with LeBron James. They have been in a process of gathering information and one interesting wrinkle that has occurred in the last several days is some of the leading suitors for LeBron James, whether that is a Golden State, a Cleveland, Miami, Minnesota, Philadelphia, some of them have been able to send a voice note to LeBron James via Rich Paul. Whether it is an owner, a president or general manager, being able to record a voice note, I am told, send it to Rich Paul and that makes its way to LeBron James. This is just a part of LeBron James' process of studying as he makes a decision.

quotes.speaker: Danny Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Danny Green argues the 76ers have a full house to land LeBron James
quotes.excerpt: They have a full house and speaking of the process, the process is now with the big JB.

text_blocks.speaker: Danny Green
text_blocks.text: They have a full house and speaking of the process, the process is now with the big JB. You have the big seven there now, you have PJ Edgecombe with the two seven, so we have three sevens on board. And if you bring the king, you have two kings. So I don't know how you beat that. You obviously have Tyrese Maxey, you have Joel Embiid. This is a really good set roster, especially when Joel is healthy. You add LeBron James to that, this is an unbelievable hand that is hard to beat.

text_blocks.speaker: Chiney Ogwumike
text_blocks.text: Tyrese Maxey is also a Klutch client.

quotes.speaker: Chiney Ogwumike
quotes.summary_phrase: Chiney Ogwumike believes LeBron James to the Warriors is a four-of-a-kind
quotes.excerpt: It is four of a kind because we are talking about four kings, four championships.
quotes.quote: It is four of a kind because we are talking about four kings, four championships. And let's think about just the synergies there. There is a lot of romance brewing. We saw it started in Paris, Steph and LeBron. You think about Draymond Green, that is his bestie as well, defensively. This four of a kind is elite. You include Steve Kerr who coached Steph and LeBron and especially in those big clutch moments. They all have four rings, so I am looking at this potential starting five, looking at how they respond well, the respect is mutual, but most importantly, can you imagine? We talk about assist to shots from Draymond to Steph. Imagine Draymond screening and finding LeBron James. The game, this would be one of the highest basketball IQs.

quotes.speaker: Bobby Marks
quotes.summary_phrase: Bobby Marks outlines the Cleveland Cavaliers' roster strength for a potential LeBron return
quotes.excerpt: When you look at Cleveland, you have got Donovan Mitchell, you have got James Harden who is going to sign.
quotes.quote: When you look at Cleveland, you have got Donovan Mitchell, you have got James Harden who is going to sign, you have got the bigs in Evan Mobley and Jared Allen, you have got the shooters off the bench in Max Strus and Sam Merrill, and young man, it is never too late to go home. There is a path to Cleveland for LeBron James.
